rationale: The distribution thesis remains mechanically intact — price is still far below session VWAP ($42.17 vs $40.33) and under the 9-EMA ($40.62), the bounce attempt to $40.84 was rejected on the heaviest volume of the window (58k), and the weak tape (SPY -0.67%, VIXY +2.11%) with the unfilled gap at $38.89 keeps the downside objective alive. A FLIP to long lacks any reversal evidence (no capitulation volume or VWAP reclaim) and closing would abandon a working setup with defined risk of ~$153 to the $40.85 invalidation versus ~$273 to the $39.40 target, roughly 1.8:1. The main caveat is proximity to the day low ($40.13) which caps conviction, but no signal yet justifies exiting at +0.70%.
